summary: Iteration 32 tested the live self vulnerability scanner + scan→compliance auto-update + advisor rename + FastAPI/Starlette upgrade regressions. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed. POST /api/self-scan/run returns score=76, complete summary keys, findings[] with cve_ids/kev/control_refs/remediation, kev_matches, remediated[]; sec-headers and cors both PASS as required. GET /latest and /history work. POST /api/self-scan/remediate toggles finding remediation status and returns updated remediated[]; unknown finding_id returns 404. /api/controls/crosswalk shows six frameworks with meeting_pct 96.7–98.9% and 'met by default (unverified)' phrasing on Crosswalk tab. /api/controls/framework/NIST 800-53 returns 4 controls with source='self-scan' (AC-7, RA-5, SC-18, SI-2). Regressions: /api/auth/me, /api/enterprise/live, /api/team, and /api/advisor/chat all healthy after FastAPI 0.115.6 / Starlette 0.41.3 upgrade; CORS preflight succeeds (handled at ingress). Frontend: /app/security loads with data-testid security-scanner-page; header placeholder = 'Ask the Obserrian Advisor…'; no 'Obserra Advisor' string remains; run-scan-btn runs a live scan and paints scan-score=76, sev-critical/high/medium/low/info chips, findings-remediate & findings-passing sections with CVE badges + 'Fix:' remediation + control_refs. Compliance → Control Crosswalk tab shows crosswalk-run-scan button, six framework tiles with correct pct, criticality strip 100/100/100/100, 'met by default (unverified)' text, and the self-test button triggers a scan and updates evidence.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash 'ReferenceError: toggleRemediate is not defined' when clicking any remediate-<id> checkbox. Line 107 calls toggleRemediate(f.id, e.target.checked) but no such function exists in the component. The 'Mark remediation complete' feature is completely broken in the UI even though the backend /api/self-scan/remediate endpoint works correctly.

issues: Same React hydration warning as iter31: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Root cause is an Emergent dev-time wrapper injecting <span x-excluded=true style=display:contents> inside <option>, but the browser still warns. Purely cosmetic in production, but noisy in dev console.

critical_code_review_comments: SecurityScanner.jsx references toggleRemediate but the function was never added — obvious missing implementation, not a subtle bug.

Two dependency findings (ecdsa 0.19.2 CVE-2024-23342, starlette 0.41.3) are EXPECTED per the review note — no upstream fixes; leaving as HIGH is honest.
